response.description:
On March 31, 2029, Azure Cosmos DB for PostgreSQL will be retired, and you'll need to migrate to Azure Database
for PostgreSQL Elastic Cluster by that date. Azure Database for PostgreSQL Elastic Cluster delivers the same
distributed PostgreSQL capabilities as Azure Cosmos DB for PostgreSQL, with
full feature parity built on the Citus extension. It adds a simpler and more
transparent pricing model, broader compute choices, and support for newer
PostgreSQL versions, while providing built-in high availability, automated
backups, point-in-time restore, and disaster recovery. Elastic Cluster also
offers elastic scaling, integrated monitoring, and the security and compliance
features of Azure Database for PostgreSQL—giving you a more streamlined,
future-ready platform without requiring application code changes. Required
action:To avoid any disruptions in service, please
migrate your existing Azure Cosmos DB for PostgreSQL databases to Azure
Database for PostgreSQL, and use Elastic Cluster option using the provided tool
for seamless migration. Review your current Azure Cosmos DB for
PostgreSQL clusters, versions, and any required extensions. Provision an Azure Database for PostgreSQL
Elastic Cluster destination environment Use the provided migration tool to move
schema and data, validate application behavior, and complete cutover. Decommission your source clusters after
successful validation of your new environment.
response.title: Retirement: Azure Cosmos DB for PostgreSQL will retire on March 31, 2029
